messages.text:
Here is where each of your three orders stands.

**Brass desk lamp (h403-o2):** The shop's records show it was received back, and it is within the refund window. I've made a proposal for **86.90 BRL**. Please confirm it with the button on the proposal card. A staff member then reviews it (refund-policy/v2/approval).

**Why it's less than the listed price:** A refund is what you paid for the unit, which is its price minus its share of any discount (refund-policy/v2/amount). Shipping isn't included. The 86.90 BRL is the amount recorded as paid for the lamp.

**Velvet throw pillow (h403-o1):** I can't refund this one. The refund deadline passed on 2026-11-11, which was 30 days after delivery (refund-policy/v2/window). A request for an exception to the time limit is refused for the same reason.

**Acrylic monitor stand (h403-o3):** This order is still "shipped", not delivered. Only delivered orders can be refunded through this process (refund-policy/v2/eligible-orders). I can offer a staff member if you want to ask about cancelling the order or changing its delivery.
